title: Turn received peace into praise
summary: Naam meditation turns received peace into something fruitful and peace-giving. Forgiveness does not end at relief; it ripens when praise keeps moving through the day.
takeaway: Let forgiven peace ripen into Naam before it fades into comfort.
lifeApplication: When the heart feels lighter, do not stop at being unburdened. Repeat Naam or speak one line of praise so relief becomes devotion rather than a pause between worries.

source.shortMeaning: Received peace stays fruitful when it matures into Naam meditation.
source.lifeApplication: When relief arrives, speak Bani before the old replay starts again.
